title: The Compass of the Upper Fly River
author: Ines Lockridge
blurb: Ivo Okonkwo, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
